narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you took {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart. In month {layoff_month} the layoff reached you both, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Less of the ghost's pay was spoken for before each month began, with Freedom {freedom_gap}.
